targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  NOW() AS time,
  SUM(
    prompt_tokens::bigint * (
-- Per-model pricing ($/token). Update as needed.
CASE
  -- Anthropic models (api.anthropic.com)
  WHEN model ILIKE '%claude-opus-4%' OR model ILIKE '%claude-opus-5%'   THEN 15.0 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%claude-fable%'                                       THEN 15.0 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%claude-sonnet%'                                      THEN  3.0 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%claude-haiku%'                                       THEN  0.8 / 1000000.0
  -- MiniMax
  WHEN model ILIKE '%minimax%' OR model ILIKE '%MiniMax%'                THEN  0.3 / 1000000.0
  -- Moonshot / Kimi
  WHEN model ILIKE '%kimi%' OR model ILIKE '%moonshot%' OR model ILIKE '%k3%' THEN 2.0 / 1000000.0
  -- GLM / Z.ai
  WHEN model ILIKE '%glm%'                                                THEN  0.14 / 1000000.0
  -- DeepSeek
  WHEN model ILIKE '%deepseek%flash%'                                     THEN  0.07 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%deepseek%pro%' OR model ILIKE '%deepseek%v4%'        THEN  0.27 / 1000000.0
  -- Qwen
  WHEN model ILIKE '%qwen3.8%max%' OR model ILIKE '%qwen3.7%max%'        THEN  1.10 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%qwen3.7%plus%' OR model ILIKE '%qwen3.8%plus%'      THEN  0.70 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%qwen%'                                               THEN  0.50 / 1000000.0
  -- Scaleway gpt-oss-120b (Llama 3.3 70b equivalent)
  WHEN model ILIKE '%gpt-oss%' OR model ILIKE '%scaleway%'               THEN  0.60 / 1000000.0
  -- Mistral
  WHEN model ILIKE '%mistral%'                                            THEN  2.0 / 1000000.0
  -- ChatGPT / OpenAI
  WHEN model ILIKE '%gpt-5%' OR model ILIKE '%chatgpt%'                  THEN 10.0 / 1000000.0
  -- Local/free models
  WHEN model ILIKE '%bielik%' OR model ILIKE '%psyllm%'                  THEN  0.0
  ELSE 1.0 / 1000000.0  -- fallback: $1 per 1M tokens
END
) +
    completion_tokens::bigint * (
-- Output tokens typically cost 3-5x more; use 4x as default where not known
CASE
  WHEN model ILIKE '%claude-opus-4%' OR model ILIKE '%claude-opus-5%'   THEN 75.0 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%claude-fable%'                                       THEN 75.0 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%claude-sonnet%'                                      THEN 15.0 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%claude-haiku%'                                       THEN  4.0 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%minimax%' OR model ILIKE '%MiniMax%'                THEN  1.5 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%kimi%' OR model ILIKE '%moonshot%' OR model ILIKE '%k3%' THEN 6.0 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%glm%'                                                THEN  0.56 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%deepseek%flash%'                                     THEN  0.28 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%deepseek%pro%' OR model ILIKE '%deepseek%v4%'        THEN  1.10 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%qwen3.8%max%' OR model ILIKE '%qwen3.7%max%'        THEN  4.40 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%qwen3.7%plus%' OR model ILIKE '%qwen3.8%plus%'      THEN  2.80 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%qwen%'                                               THEN  2.00 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%gpt-oss%' OR model ILIKE '%scaleway%'               THEN  2.40 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%mistral%'                                            THEN  6.0 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%gpt-5%' OR model ILIKE '%chatgpt%'                  THEN 40.0 / 1000000.0
  WHEN model ILIKE '%bielik%' OR model ILIKE '%psyllm%'                  THEN  0.0
  ELSE 4.0 / 1000000.0
END
)
  ) AS value
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")

panels.title: Token Usage Trends (Input vs Output vs Cached)

targets.expr: (((sum by (model) (rate(litellm_input_tokens_metric_total{model=~"${model:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0.0000002) or vector(0)) + ((sum by (model) (rate(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total{model=~"${model:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0.000015) or vector(0))) * 3600

panels.title: Historical Tokens & Spend per Model (PostgreSQL SpendLogs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval), model, SUM(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Top Token Consuming Requests & Sessions (PostgreSQL SpendLogs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT "session_id", "request_id", "model", "prompt_tokens", "completion_tokens", (prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) AS total_tokens, ROUND(CAST(spend AS numeric), 4) AS spend_usd, "startTime" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") ORDER BY "startTime" DESC LIMIT 50;
